title: Complete solution to the weak persistent center and isochronous center problems of cubic polynomial systems
summary: In this paper, we investigate weakly persistent centers for several classes of planar cubic differential systems, including systems with a nondegenerate linear center and systems with a nilpotent center. Necessary parameter relations are obtained by computing singular point quantities or quasi-Lyapunov constants, while their sufficiency is established by suitable analytic constructions.
